title: Cross-team Activation Buckets & Sprint Risk Scoring for Private Deployments
creator: Jonas Meyer
description:
Problem: Our current private/VPC/on-prem quarterly rollout playbooks are calendar-driven and lack a standardized, quantifiable risk signal for deciding which customer cohorts to activate in each tranche. This causes last-minute gates, uneven engineering load, and missed OKR targets related to time-to-activation and stability.

Goal: Create a cross-functional mechanism (Activation Buckets + Sprint Risk Scoring) that maps engineering readiness signals, product acceptance criteria, security/compliance gating, and customer priority into deterministic cohort activation lanes. Outputs should tie directly to OKR metrics (activation lead time, upgrade failure rate, mean time to revert) and provide actionable prescriptive next steps per bucket.
acceptance_criteria: A standardized Risk Score is defined and documented, composed of >=5 signals (compat_coverage, infra_readiness_score, security_cert_status, integration_test_pass_rate, customer_priority_tier)
A mapping matrix (Risk Score -> Activation Bucket) exists and is reviewed by PM, Eng, and Security leads
Console shows per-tenant Activation Bucket and a readout of contributing signals (mock data acceptable) in the rollout dashboard
Runbook includes per-bucket escalation and rollback thresholds and is signed off by SRE
Pilot with 3 lighthouse customers executed in Cycle 57 and telemetry collected to validate scoring precision and OKR impact
tasks: Design risk signal definitions and thresholds (PM + Eng + Security)
Instrument telemetry hooks for each signal in the private deployment pipeline (ENG)
Add Activation Bucket column to rollout cohort spreadsheet and Console staging UI (Design + Eng)
Draft runbook text for bucket-specific gating, escalations, and rollback
Coordinate pilot with Solutions and 3 selected lighthouse customers

decisions: Use a 0-100 consolidated Risk Score, where lower is safer. Signals are weighted: compat_coverage(30%), infra_readiness(25%), security_cert(20%), integration_tests(15%), customer_priority(10%).
Activation Buckets: Canary (0-30), Early (31-55), Broad (56-80), Open (81-100)
Telemetry readouts will be ingested into Console with 7-day rolling aggregates for each signal and per-tenant scoring.
Pilot will intentionally include one high-risk customer to validate rollback playbook.
